records.source_meaning: Angelo recommends looking farther afield where Africa and the New World have room to grow and small investments can pay off handsomely.
records.Japanese:
やっぱ、外に行かねえとな
アフリカや新大陸は、まだまだ発展する
余地がある。ちょっとの投資で
大きな見返りがあるんだ
records.previous_English: You've got to head farther out. Africa and the New World still have plenty of room to grow. A little investment can bring a big return.
records.english: Head farther out. Africa and the New World have room to grow. Invest a little and you can earn a lot.
records.localization_note: The compact advice connects the investment to the available opportunities and keeps the two destinations together.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini

records.source_meaning: Angelo expects unusual goods to bring easy profits from round trips to Europe.
records.Japanese:
しかも、売ってる交易品が珍しいから
ヨーロッパと往復するだけで
簡単に大金が転がり込んでくる
はずさ
records.previous_English: And they've got unusual goods. Just hauling them back and forth to Europe should bring in a fortune.
records.english: And they've got unusual goods. You could make a fortune just trading back and forth with Europe.
records.localization_note: The round trips, unusual goods and easy profit remain part of the same claim, with the payoff together.

Angelo drops the bravado long enough to thank him, then gives him trade advice. The alternate crew path includes Julio's assessment of the same advice.
records.source_meaning: Julio explains why extra cargo holds do little good in Europe when market share is hard to obtain and limits bulk trading.
records.Japanese:
せっかく船を買って積荷倉庫が
増えても、なかなかシェアを取れぬ
ヨーロッパでは、交易品を一度に
たくさん商うことができんからのう
records.previous_English: More cargo holds won't help much in Europe. It's hard to get market share there, and you can't trade in bulk without it.
records.english: More cargo holds won't help much in Europe. It's hard to get market share there, and you can't trade in bulk without it.
records.localization_note: The existing causal chain makes both qualifications clear and keeps the established term market share.
